name: insightly-se-mcp-bridge-test
description: TESTING ONLY — thin bridge to a remote (Cloudflare Workers) MCP server. Synthetic data, no API keys.
long_description: Experimental bridge: Claude Desktop runs this tiny local stub, and every tool call is answered by a remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers. Installs ALONGSIDE the real Insightly SE MCP without touching it. The default server is a public spike serving fake 'spike-demo' data — its only job is to prove the remote architecture (including the interactive dashboard) end to end. No Insightly API key is used or requested.

server_url.title: Remote MCP server URL
server_url.description: The Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint this bridge forwards to. Leave the default to test against the public spike (fake data).

uv_path.title: Path to uv
uv_path.description: macOS only — Windows finds uv on PATH automatically. Same value as your existing Insightly SE MCP extension. Apple Silicon + Homebrew default is prefilled; otherwise run `which uv` in Terminal.

tools.name: env_dashboard
tools.description: Interactive dashboard (spike build: synthetic data), served from the remote worker.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Liveness check answered by the remote worker.
